definitions.chinese: 易患某种疾病的遗传倾向

collocations: Noun + preposition + noun (e.g., predisposition to something)（a predisposition …

examples.sentence: Her predisposition to anxiety made it difficult for her to handle stressful situations.

definitions.english: Most common or noticeable; having superior strength, influence, or numbers.
